notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Five more of the best new games on Steam
notes.content:
It’s that time of the year when joyless, faintly plastic robots insist that you forego the few pleasures January has to offer, calling you a big lazy drunk and demanding you join their dull, weight-obsessed ranks. But not here, friends! This is where we find new joy. It’s Unknown Pleasures.

This week we finish off the knock-off Baileys with button-mashing Empire management, queer aristocratic romance, and murderous teenaged narcissists.

(more…)

notes.title: HC3 Releasing on January 5th, 2018
notes.content:
Hello Charlotte EP3: Childhood's End, the final episode in the main story, will be released on 05/01/2018.

If you're new to the series, you can play the episodes in their release order:

EP1: [url=https://etherane.itch.io/hello-charlotte-ep1] itch.io [/url] 
EP2: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/557630/Hello_Charlotte/]Steam[/url] 
Delirium: [url=https://etherane.itch.io/hello-charlotte-delirium] itch.io [/url] 

See you soon!
